thesis: Transmute Artifact turned an expendable artifact into the exact machine a deck needed, previewing the dangerous tutor-and-cheat design space later occupied by Tinker.

canonicalIdentity.currentOracleText: Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, search your library for an artifact card. If that card's mana value is less than or equal to the sacrificed artifact's mana value, put it onto the battlefield. If it's greater, you may pay {X}, where X is the difference. If you do, put it onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard. Then shuffle.

originalContext.designPurpose: Transmute Artifact is a tutor with a consequential timing detail: its artifact sacrifice happens when the sorcery resolves, not when the spell is cast. Countering it can prevent any artifact from being sacrificed.
